name: Gideoni
title: Father of Abidan from the tribe of Benjamin
summary: Gideoni is known from the Bible as the father of Abidan, who was a leader and prince of the tribe of Benjamin during the wilderness wanderings. He is mentioned in connection with the census and the arrangement of the tribes in the desert. Although little is known about his personal life, his family played an important role in organizing the people of Israel.

keyEvents.title: Abidan appointed as leader of Benjamin
keyEvents.description: Gideoni's son Abidan was appointed leader of the tribe of Benjamin when the Lord spoke to Moses in the wilderness of Sinai.

keyEvents.title: The tribe of Benjamin in the camp
keyEvents.description: Abidan, son of Gideoni, led the tribe of Benjamin in the camp arrangement and was positioned on the west side of the tabernacle under the banner of Ephraim.

keyEvents.title: Offering at the dedication of the altar
keyEvents.description: Abidan, son of Gideoni, brought his offering on the ninth day during the dedication of the altar in the tabernacle.

keyEvents.title: Leader of Benjamin's army
keyEvents.description: Abidan, son of Gideoni, was appointed leader over the military division of the tribe of Benjamin during Israel's journey through the wilderness.
